source.title: How Guys Are Styling Oversized T-Shirts (Gymshark)

tips.text: Balance an oversized tee with straight or tapered bottoms, or go fully relaxed with baggy cargos for a streetwear look; avoid super skinny jeans.
An oversized tee with shorts should end just below the waistband so the shorter bottom balances it.
tips.why: Shorter bottoms let the tee run longer.

tips.text: A tee cropped near the waistband balances slouchy, baggy jeans.
tips.why: A short top offsets loose bottoms.

tips.text: Dress up an oversized tee with tailored trousers or a structured coat for contrast.
tips.why: Mixing casual and smart adds interest.

tips.text: Keep oversized tees out of formal and business settings.
tips.why: They suit relaxed dress codes only.

tips.text: A graphic tee goes well with an all-black outfit, light baggy denim or cargos.

outfits.outfit: tshirt white oversized casual, shorts black casual, sneakers white casual
tshirt black oversized streetwear, trousers olive baggy streetwear +cargo, sneakers black streetwear
outfits.why: Baggy cargos with an oversized tee: relaxed, not scruffy.

outfits.outfit: tshirt grey oversized casual, jeans denim straight casual, sneakers white casual
outfits.why: Straighter jeans balance a baggy tee.

outfits.outfit: tshirt white cropped casual, jeans light blue baggy casual, sneakers white casual
outfits.why: A cropped tee balances slouchy denim.

outfits.outfit: coat smart, tshirt white oversized minimal, trousers grey smart casual, sneakers white minimal
outfits.why: Tailored trousers and a structured coat add smart contrast.

outfits.outfit: tshirt black oversized streetwear, joggers grey straight streetwear, sneakers white streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: Straight sweatpants and high-tops: a streetwear staple.

outfits.outfit: tshirt white oversized casual, trousers grey smart, dress-shoes black smart
outfits.why: Oversized tees clash with business settings.
